note: PARTLY COMPUTED FROM THE AUTHORS' TRIAL-LEVEL DATA. Sources: the design ancestor is Constantino, S. M. & Daw, N. D. (2015), Cogn Affect Behav Neurosci 15(4):837-853 (doi:10.3758/s13415-015-0350-y), which manipulates travel TIME as this port does; the human data come from Bustamante et al. (2023), PNAS 120(50):e2221510120, whose Effort Foraging Task adapts that paradigm, data openly available at osf.io/a4r2e, file data/experiment_1/choiceData_experiment_1.csv (350,608 decisions from n=537 participants, matching the paper's analysed sample). prop_stay_overall 0.871 (sd 0.075) is DIRECTLY MEASURED: the proportion of harvest-or-exit decisions that were 'stay', per participant. It supersedes the 0.65 estimate. RESIDENCE TIMES ARE CALIBRATED, NOT TRANSFERRED, and the reason matters. Bustamante's travel_duration is fixed at 8.33 s in BOTH conditions - only the effort differs - whereas this port varies travel TIME (4 s vs 8 s) at no effort. Their observed residence times are 8.089 harvests (sd 4.114) at low effort and 8.539 (sd 4.225) at high effort, but those reflect their own start reward (15 apples) and harvest time (1.0 s), which give an MVT optimum of 9 harvests, against 5 and 7 for this port's parameters. Transferring the raw numbers would therefore be wrong. What DOES transfer is how far humans sit from the optimum: 8.089/9 = 0.90 at low effort and 8.539/9 = 0.95 at high. Applying the low-effort ratio, which is the closer analogue since this port imposes no effort, to this port's own MVT optima gives 5 x 0.90 = 4.5 and 7 x 0.90 = 6.3. SDs use their observed coefficient of variation (~0.51 and ~0.49), which is large and empirically grounded: residence time varies enormously between people. NOTE ON DIRECTION: humans in this dataset slightly UNDER-harvest relative to MVT (ratios 0.90-0.95), not over. An earlier version of this file asserted overharvesting as the robust finding and set the baselines accordingly; the data do not support that here. DEPLETION RATE MATCHES EXACTLY: Bustamante's depletion_rate_mean is 0.88 on every row, which is this port's decay_rate_mean. total_reward 32 and mvt_optimal_match_rate 0.7 remain author estimates; neither is a quantity the source data expose in a comparable form.
